messages:
kevin: Kicking off the three-phase cutover plan today. US -> EU -> APAC. Need quick capacity sanity for each region and confirmation on pin/rollback rules. Targeting change window 20:00-22:00 UTC for US slice.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy created: service/frontend v2026.03.15-rc3. Rollout plan: 10% canary -> 50% -> 100% per region. Pins: US pinned to v2026.03.15-rc3 for 30m canary. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026.03.15-rc3 :rocket:

maria: US capacity check: reserved pool 1200 RPS, current avg 420 RPS. With canary and warm-up we have ~1.6x cushion. EU pool 800 RPS, avg 380 RPS -> tight but workable for progressive ramp. APAC pool 450 RPS, avg 210 RPS -> low cushion, flagged maintenance window on some hosts.

sasha: Re APAC - we have a scheduled node swap at 21:30 UTC that might reduce capacity by ~30%. Recommend shifting APAC final cutover +1h or enable burst capacity (ops quota). Also suggest enabling fallback to model-quantized variant if tail latency spikes. :warning:

alan: Rollback criteria proposal (short): sustained 5m error rate >2% OR 99th latency >2s for canary slice OR GPU utilization >92% sustained 3m -> automatic pin to previous stable (v2026.02.28). Manual rollback allowed at any time. Agree?

maria: Ack on rollback metrics. Ops notes: automatic pin action will call the rollout controller and notify #oncall. We tested the pin script yesterday.

oncall-team: @kevin we'll be on standby. Oncall runbook link: https://redwood.internal/oncall/runbooks/rollout. Paging policy set to pager:critical for regressions.

kevin: Okay sounds good. Maria, can you do a final preflight 15m before US canary? Sasha, please confirm APAC decision by +30m so we can adjust the scheduled window.

maria: Will run smoke tests and quota recheck at T-15. Quick smoke commands I run: 
```
# smoke: basic health
curl -sS https://us.api.redwood/v2/health | jq .status
# small gen
curl -sS -X POST https://us.api.redwood/v2/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":5}'
```

sasha: APAC decision: delay APAC final ramp by 1h. We'll enable burst capacity via reserved-burst policy and pre-warm 2 extra nodes. I'll update the rollout controller config. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deploy started (US canary) at 1749991320. Canary slice 10% of traffic. Observability hooks live.

maria: Canary health after 5m: error rate 0.1%, 95th latency 320ms, token throughput normal. No anomalies.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics: latency_p95=320ms, error_rate=0.12%, gpu_util=45%. All checks green. Proceeding to 50% per plan.

alan: If anything degrades during 50% ramp, trigger automatic pin and notify #eng-releases. Keep the canary holdpoint for APAC until Sasha confirms.

kevin: Thanks team. I'll post release notes summary in #product after full roll. Keep this thread for ops updates only.
